name: The Devil's Judgment
source:
According to the report, a young man was found collapsed in an alley near the main avenue. He was barely conscious as he muttered incoherent words no one could understand.

The police took him into custody, but when the paramedics examined him, they found that despite the blood coming from his mouth, there wasn't a single wound on his body. 


Now it's your turn to uncover the truth.

Question the mysterious man, separate fact from deception, and decide whether you're facing a lost soul or something far more sinister.

[From [url=https://honeybunny-of.itch.io/the-judgment]itch.io[/url]]
